name: Lunara
author: Adlux
description: Comfort-wear theme (Lunara / Shrine PRO design): sale bar with countdown, banner, product grid and real reviews on the home page; product page with gallery, Kaching-style bundle packs (per-item Color / Size), description, reviews with write-a-review form and FAQ; cart drawer, Products catalog, About / policy pages, order tracking and checkout. Primary colour #124F9F, editable. Extra product template "Shapecurve – Drop-seat bodysuit" (from shape-curve.com): picture colour tiles + size pills, Find my size (weight + height, US / metric, as getionix.com), Buy 1 / 2 / 3 packs, Express checkout, shipping box, info rows with size chart, feature cards, details, photo testimonials, trust badges; highlight #790236, Poppins.
